minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  January 15, 2019

  The Finance Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
  Tuesday, January 15. 2019, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance
  Authority and Parking Authority at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Finance
  Authority Secretary and Parking Authority Secretary announced the presence of a
  quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman and Parking
  Authority Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor
  Agency Members/Housing Authority Members/ Finance
  Authority Members/Parking Authority Members Dotson,
  Padilla, Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority and Parking Authority
  officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Wanda Brown  City Treasurer/Treasurer*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Patricia McNish  Management Assistant

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance Authority
  and Parking Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/ Finance Authority Chairman and Parking
  Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to
  address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority and
  Parking Authority on any item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

  FINANCE AUTHORITY MINUTES. It was moved by Finance Authority Member
  Franklin, and seconded by Finance Authority Member Dotson that the Minutes for the
  Finance Authority meetings held on November 27, 2018, and December 4, 2018, be
  approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Finance Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and
  Finance Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes:  None.

219  FINANCE AUTHORITY TREASURER - MONTHLY TREASURER’S REPORT.
  Staff report dated January 15, 2019 was presented submitting the Monthly Treasurer’s
  Report for the month ending October 31, 2018.

  Finance Authority Chairman Butts ordered the report received and filed.

  1
 January 15, 2019

  There being no further business to be presented, Finance Authority Chairman Butts
  declared the meeting adjourned at the hour of 2:23 p.m.

  Approved this 5th day of February 2019

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, Secretary

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
